facts.fact: Nielsen's Gauge data show free ad-supported streaming services (FAST) collectively captured 5.7% of total U.S. TV viewing in May 2025.
facts.quote: Free ad-supported streaming services collectively captured 5.7% of total TV viewing in May 2025.

facts.fact: Per TV Technology research, 45% of U.S. internet households regularly watch FAST services.
facts.quote: 45% of U.S. internet households now regularly watch FAST services.

facts.fact: Per TV Technology research, the share of U.S. internet households watching FAST services rose from 30% in 2022 to 45%.
facts.quote: This represents a dramatic increase from just 30% in 2022

facts.fact: Per Comscore, time spent on major ad-supported streaming services increased by 43% in 2025 compared to the previous year.
facts.quote: Time spent on major ad-supported streaming services increased by 43% in 2025 compared to the previous year

facts.fact: Per Statista, U.S. FAST advertising revenue is projected to reach $5.78 billion in 2025.
facts.quote: projected to reach $5.78 billion in 2025

facts.fact: Industry analysts project the FAST market will grow at a compound annual growth rate of 16.9% through 2033.
facts.quote: compound annual growth rate of 16.9% through 2033

facts.fact: Industry analysts project the FAST market could reach $40 billion globally by 2033.
facts.quote: potentially reaching $40 billion globally by that time.

facts.fact: Tubi had approximately 100 million monthly active users as of June 2025, per the page.
facts.quote: approximately 100 million monthly active users as of June 2025

facts.fact: Tubi generated an estimated $700 million in revenue in 2023, per the page.

facts.fact: Adwave states that businesses can start streaming TV advertising campaigns with budgets as low as $30 a day.

facts.quote: Start with a modest budget (even $100-200 for initial testing) and run for at least two weeks to gather meaningful data.

facts.quote: FAST CPMs typically range from $15-30, depending on platform, targeting, and inventory type.

facts.fact: Adwave says effective CPMs for small business advertisers using its platform often fall in the $20-25 range.
facts.quote: For small business advertisers using platforms like Adwave, effective CPMs often fall in the $20-25 range.
